name: get_grant
description: Read one approval request or grant: exact reviewed configuration, requester/reviewer, original effective expiry and reservations. Ad hoc grants retain personal capture/result-access scope. Team policy grants show their real workload, policy/executor, finite ceilings and spent grant reservations; no personal capture or evidence access is created. Direct policy lookup permits an eligible requester, current reviewer or exact current pinned team manager; other callers receive not available. Shared policy and admission limits remain independently binding. Existing-artifact rawQuery approvals show exact selected files, verified sizes, targets, requesting client and finite download budgets; they authorize no collection. With after_revision the call waits server-side (at most 30 s) for the next decision or state change.

after_revision.description: Wait server-side until the state revision differs from this value or 30 seconds pass, then return the current state. Omit for an immediate read. Status reads are never charged.

lifetime_seconds.description: Approval window in seconds, bounded by the administrator-configured maximum.

preview_deadline.description: Original passive preview expiry; bounds opening a new approval review, and also start for legacy previewDeadline plans.

capture_deadline_rule.description: Manual preview/acceptance window, or the separately accepted team-policy authority bound by original request-anchored grant expiry.

capture_window_seconds.description: Maximum window fixed once at acceptance, never beyond original approval expiry.

can_resume.description: Advisory current original requester/client collection eligibility under this exact approved grant. Submission rechecks all authority.
